desc: 蓝白清泉色系套图，覆盖白底主图、卖点微距、换芯场景与空表对照
name: 净水壶替换滤芯清泉蓝调款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清是同型多支的替换耗材，拿下首屏点击
一秒把核心利益主张钉在蓝色主视觉上，留出干净的标题空版
用同机位双栏放大耗材用久后的浑浊状态，制造换芯紧迫感
用微距证明做工与进水结构，把质感变成可信度
把换芯放回真实厨房动线，让买家代入自家水壶
以剖视线稿解释结构原理，参数位全部留空不自证
保留多品牌横向对照的分镜骨架，主张与品牌全部留白
并排三档选型帮助买家确认自己该拿哪一栏，首栏高亮
用举杯看水的动作完成场景代入，人脸全部裁掉规避肖像
沿用圆形印章加斜跨缎带的信任版式，但资质一律留空待贴
以空版零售盒加单支做收口，把促销位留给后期真实优惠

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, flat saturated blue #2E6FE8 and deep navy #103A66 graphic fields for infographic screens, pale sky #A9D4EE and marble #E9E7E3 for lifestyle scenes; never a random unrelated backdrop
style.direction: clean drinking-water accessory commerce in cool aqua blue
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and hollow circular marker outlines in #7FC7E8, never filled data marks
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, one controlled specular along the moulded shell, soft contact shadows that ground every unit, cool cast held identical across the set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean drinking-water accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, saturated blue #2E6FE8, deep navy #103A66 and light aqua accent #7FC7E8; cool high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and one controlled specular on moulded shells; modern geometric sans-serif held for post-production only while every copy area renders as a clean empty panel; consistent thin single-weight line icon style with hollow marker outlines; flat colour graphic fields or seamless white sweeps only, never random backdrops; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle and scale on every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no filled-in claims or badges or table values, no redesign of the product silhouette.
noDrift: no filled-in claims, badges or table values
no redesign of the product silhouette
style.presentationRules: identical slight 3/4 or straight-on angle and stable scale for the product on every screen; crops always sit on the same body section so the unit reads as one object across the set
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, polished marble counter #E9E7E3, flat colour graphic panels #2E6FE8 / #14688C / #103A66
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production only; every headline and label area ships as a clean empty panel with no glyphs
